subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and providers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this combined opt-in readiness contract—including the new configuration, Gateway RPC/CLI projections, and Plugin SDK API—as a supported core platform surface?
rationale: The implementation appears intentional and proof-backed, but selecting a permanent public contract and its ownership boundary is a product and compatibility decision that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Sponsor the full readiness contract
options.body: Accept the opt-in configuration, public projections, and Plugin SDK criterion API as one supported platform surface, subject to exact-merge upgrade proof.

options.title: Request a narrower core slice
options.body: Keep canonical core readiness only and defer the Plugin SDK API or selected provider mechanism until their long-term contracts are separately approved.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause the PR until the RFC and owners establish whether configurable deployment readiness belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full readiness contract
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in configuration, public projections, and Plugin SDK criterion API as one supported platform surface, subject to exact-merge upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the visible RFC and implementation driver and can incorporate the sponsoring owners’ chosen scope.
